children: Reliance Global Group executed financing-related actions to support the sale of Southwestern Montana Insurance Center (SMI). A Sixth Amendment to the Master Credit Agreement with Oak Street Funding permits allocating 50% of sale proceeds, or $1,207,324.67, to a specific term loan, allowing the company to retain the remaining proceeds. Upon the paydown, Oak Street will release SMI as a borrower and lift its liens on SMI assets; the amendment includes a $15,000 fee. Additionally, Reliance Global and affiliated guarantors reaffirmed their guarantees and consented to the amendment.
